title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 124 ]

blocks.text: Walking down the street, you may not even notice the trees, but, according to a new study, they do a lot more than give shade. Environmental scientists chose two Chicago public housing projects, both of which had some buildings with lots of trees nearby, and some with practically none. According to the study, violence and property crimes were nearly twice as high in sections of the buildings where vegetation was low, compared with the sections where vegetation was high. Why? One explanation: Greenery creates a natural gathering space for neighbors and, ultimately, stronger bonds in the community. This can also create an atmosphere where children are better supervised, and buildings better watched.

readingSentences.english: Walking down the street, you may not even notice the trees, but, according to a new study, they do a lot more than give shade.
readingSentences.korean: 거리를 걸을 때 나무를 전혀 의식하지 못할 수도 있지만, 새로운 연구에 따르면 나무는 단지 그늘을 제공하는 것 이상의 많은 일을 한다.

readingSentences.english: Environmental scientists chose two Chicago public housing projects, both of which had some buildings with lots of trees nearby, and some with practically none.
readingSentences.korean: 환경 과학자들은 시카고의 공공 주택 단지 두 곳을 선택했는데, 두 곳 모두 주변에 나무가 많은 건물들과 사실상 나무가 거의 없는 건물들이 함께 있었다.

readingSentences.english: According to the study, violence and property crimes were nearly twice as high in sections of the buildings where vegetation was low, compared with the sections where vegetation was high.
readingSentences.korean: 연구에 따르면 녹지가 적은 건물 구역에서의 폭력 및 재산 범죄는 녹지가 풍부한 구역에 비해 거의 두 배나 높게 나타났다.

readingSentences.english: One explanation: Greenery creates a natural gathering space for neighbors and, ultimately, stronger bonds in the community.
readingSentences.korean: 한 가지 설명은 녹지가 이웃 주민들을 위한 자연스러운 모임 공간을 만들어 내고, 궁극적으로 지역 사회 내에 더 강한 유대감을 형성한다는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: This can also create an atmosphere where children are better supervised, and buildings better watched.
readingSentences.korean: 이것은 또한 아이들이 더 잘 보살핌을 받고 건물들이 더 잘 감시되는 안전한 분위기를 만들어 낼 수 있다.
